about.title: About
about.headline: A professional profile focused on web systems, integrations, automation, and infrastructure.
about.intro: I'm Gabriel Henrique Dagostim, {{age}} years old. I enjoy building web systems, integrating tools, improving processes, automating routines, and organizing infrastructure so operations can work better.
about.photoAlt: Gabriel Henrique Dagostim in a datacenter environment
about.buildBody: Web systems, system-to-system integrations, automations, process improvements, dashboards, bots, central auth, and tools that make operations more organized.
about.educationSubtitle: My base started with programming electronic devices and applied research, moved through fairs and competitions, and evolved into software engineering and production web systems.
about.profileWebBody: Focused on turning operational problems into web apps, dashboards, automation flows, and system integrations.
about.profileCompetitionBody: Participated in hackathons and national timed development competitions, including three consecutive podiums at the Show Rural Digital Hackathon.
about.profileResearchBody: Two years as an undergraduate research student through Código Kid and Eureka, building electronic prototypes, joining national and international fairs, and earning international awards.
about.profileOpsBody: Experience organizing infrastructure, standardizing environments, connecting systems, and creating automations that reduce manual effort.
about.eduFagBody: Software Engineering degree, consolidating my base in development, architecture, product, quality, and systems delivery.
about.eduCompetitionsOrg: Show Rural Digital, national and international fairs
about.eduCompetitionsBody: Recurring participation in hackathons and timed development competitions, with three consecutive podiums at the Show Rural Digital Hackathon and projects recognized for problem-solving focus.
about.eduResearchBody: Electronic prototype development, international project interactions, participation in national and international fairs, and awards in the electronics track.
about.eduCodigoKidBody: Studied programming applied to electronic devices, logic, Arduino, and prototyping, creating the practical base that later evolved into software and automation.
about.careerSubtitle: From campus ops and AD at Unioeste to senior systems and automation at Farmácias Estrela.
about.jobEstrelaBody: Senior infra and development: integrations, automations, and new internal systems (Feirão tracking, expiry control, Nexus, Auth, e-commerce images, DBA bots, and the IT installer).
about.jobEstrelaNote: Internal systems shown in this portfolio — no public links, screenshots only.
about.jobUnioesteBody: Three years keeping campuses online: Active Directory controllers, networking, and the same blend I do today — stable infra plus software to support the environment.
about.focusText: My profile combines product thinking, an electronics technical base, web development, and infrastructure experience. I like understanding the process before coding, finding the bottleneck, and shipping something that truly improves the routine.

skills.subtitle: Capabilities shown in the portfolio — what I can build for your operation.
skills.headline: What I can deliver — based on what I've already built.
skills.lead: The portfolio cases show the path. Here's what I can do for your operation: web systems, integrations, automations, infrastructure organization, and tools that actually help people in day-to-day work.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.body: Clear, fast interfaces: dashboards, approval flows, i18n, and motion that supports the work without getting in the way.

backend.title: Backend & APIs
backend.body: REST services, authentication, database integrations, and storage — the base so systems and automations can talk to each other.

infra.title: Infrastructure & networks
infra.body: Structural organization of environments: servers, Active Directory, Linux, Docker, networking, and standardization for stable operations.

automation.title: Automation & bots
automation.body: Building bots with integrations and custom features tailored to the operation — cutting manual work and fitting the real workflow.

dataAi.title: Data & applied AI
dataAi.body: Knowledge structures for local LLMs, smart queries (NL→SQL), data joins, and reports the team can actually use.

delivery.title: Internal product delivery
delivery.body: Useful systems that help operators and end users — from understanding the process to an interface that speeds up the day.

skills.howTitle: How I turn this into results
skills.howBody: I don't split “infra” from “dev”: I understand the process, find the bottleneck, and ship something operations actually use — panel, bot, integration, or automation.
skills.how1: Map the process and the operator or end-user pain.
skills.how2: Integrate systems and data to avoid rework and loose spreadsheets.
skills.how3: Automate the repetitive with tailored bots and jobs.
skills.how4: Ship a simple, stable interface ready for daily use.
